success_cleanup_and_return.vertex: Disassemble+native diagnostic then CreateVertexShader; release assembly, bytecode/messages; return CreateVertexShader HRESULT.
success_cleanup_and_return.pixel: CreatePixelShader first; both masks enable disassembly/usage; optional disassembly HRESULT overwrites creation HRESULT in savedreturn slot+20; release assembly,bytecode/messages.
success_cleanup_and_return.code_null_failure: Return compileHRESULT directly; no retry/substitute/API fallback; native cleanup bypass can leak errorbuffer.
success_cleanup_and_return.host_raii_boundary: Always releasing returned COMbuffers is a host cleanup improvement; preserve actual error status rather than reproducing native leaks.
